panels.description: Mera holds her pearl-grey band above the two linked Covenant bands. Keep upper bands clear.
Mera places her band beside the others on the station table. Keep upper table clear.
The three bands link into a complete circle without any command display activating. Keep upper circle clear.
Ada lifts the linked Covenant while B11 secures the Measure and Maker's Seal in fitted compartments. Keep upper objects clear.

items.speaker: MERA
items.text: I know the door closed. I know B11 activated. I don’t know what happened after.

items.speaker: MERA
items.text: Review my records. Remove me if I hide one.
